packet.summary: AIVEXUS-BASE-2 exact-head review handoff for PR #832 at 82b5ac57f9132775fd0695eebb4d2de834c860ed, based on merged BASE-1 main b5840bc680d7831d2df191d2cc8e39a9e45c08cd. Adds one shared phone-oriented project-type selector/navigation path for App/Software, Stampa 3D and Videogiochi. CAD/Game create persistent BASE-1-backed drafts and reopen from the same project list without invoking inference or simulating generation. The Codex P2 about changing kind while editing software was fixed and regression-tested. All six exact-head workflows are successful; Codex re-review of the final head reports no major issues. No CAD-1, GAME-1, domain runner, deploy or physical/runtime acceptance is claimed.
changes: Adds a shared project-type selector for App/Software, Stampa 3D and Videogiochi in the existing Cantiere project creation flow.
New software projects persist an explicit ProjectExtension software kind while preserving the existing proposal/approval lifecycle.

Stampa 3D and Videogiochi create persistent domain drafts through the same BASE-1 WorkshopWebProject storage; game drafts declare Web while CAD drafts leave platform selection to the future domain runner.
Project cards and detail navigation expose the persisted project kind and reopen all supported kinds from the same shared project list.
CAD/Game detail explicitly states that the specialized runner is not connected and no generation is simulated.
Software editing forces and locks the project kind to software, preventing a stale CAD/Game selection from silently creating a second project.
Focused widget regression verifies CAD/Game draft persistence without inference plus software edit identity preservation; Web CI includes the new selector suite.

CAD/Game drafts must continue to show runner unavailable and must never simulate generated files, playable builds, meshes or completion.

The shared Web project list remains browser-origin/profile local; BASE-2 does not add cross-device synchronization.
